name: depth-first choice with undo
mechanism: extend a partial solution one choice at a time; when a partial solution cannot be completed, undo the last choice and try the next alternative

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Backtracking' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Graph search: abandons partial solutions when they are found not to satisfy a complete solution
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Beam stack search': integrates backtracking with beam search

requires: a feasibility test on partial solutions
